newsitem.title: DUBAI: GCC foreign ministers to meet in Riyadh.
newsitem.headline: GCC foreign ministers to meet in Riyadh.

text.p: Foreign ministers of the six Arab Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) states are to hold a two-day routine quarterly meeting on Saturday, an official at the Riyadh-based GCC secretariat said on Tuesday.
"It is a scheduled meeting of the foreign ministers with no extraordinary items on its agenda," the official who declined to be named told Reuters by telephone.
"The meeting is not related to the latest developments in Iraq. The Council will issue a statement detailing any special topics to be discussed," he added.
On the agenda is the Middle East peace process, Iraq's compliance with U.N. Gulf War resolutions, and other technical matters, the official said.
The GCC groups Saudi Arabia, Bahrain, Qatar, Oman, Kuwait and the United Arab Emirates.
